message:
test(host): print the three budgets instead of one total

Test 1. Built, not run here -- see the last paragraph.

a236e1e put spawn, wait, teardown and the lingering flag on the result and nothing printed them,
so the suite still reported one number per path. That is the shape of the reporting mistake the
reviewer objected to: "549ms against a 400ms deadline" says the deadline held and hides which of
the three budgets the rest belonged to.

The probe carries all four back now and the summary prints a line per path. The timeout path also
gained two checks, because that is where the split has consequences: the wait is what the deadline
bounds, and the teardown is a separate budget of up to kKillConfirmMs on top. A call that times out
and then meets a helper that will not die can take about six seconds. Saying "one second deadline"
without that is how somebody later reads a six second stall as impossible.

Not run in this session. The suite starts capture processes, and the user asked -- twice -- who
kept starting things on their machine; I said I would not until they answered, and they have not.
The reviewer is right that this particular suite starts no host, opens no socket and raises no
firewall prompt, which is what they actually objected to. It does still take desktop screenshots,
and the distinction is theirs to draw rather than mine to assume.

It costs nothing to wait: the reviewer runs this suite on every verification pass -- 26 of 26,
three times, in their last one -- so the table appears in their next run without anyone starting
anything extra.
